rationale: This article examines collective commercialisation of recyclables and a micro-credit fund managed by recycling cooperatives in São Paulo to alleviate poverty among waste pickers/recyclers. It does not address household or community drinking water or sanitation service access (E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because the record fails Criterion 1 (it examines solid waste recycling cooperatives and micro-credit for recyclers rather than household or community water or sanitation service access).

evidence_quotes.quote: Solidarity economy and recycling co-ops in São Paulo: micro-credit to alleviate poverty
The article discusses collective commercialisation and the micro-credit fund created among 30 recycling groups in the Brazilian city of São Paulo.
